tasks.answer: Use DeleteDiscussion, the feature-level destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion. It takes the discussion id and wraps the shared confirmation-dialog UI.

The login input is Input. It binds to react-hook-form through the required registration prop (Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>), i.e. the object returned by register(); it must be used inside Form so FieldWrapper supplies the label and error message.
The discussion list uses TablePagination. It renders page-number links and needs totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl (it builds hrefs from the root URL and current page).
MDPreview renders Markdown as sanitized HTML with prose typography; its input prop is value.
CreateDiscussion is the admin-only drawer form for creating a discussion with a title and Markdown body; it requires admin permission/role.

notes: Five searches (one per task) plus one get (ui.form.Input --prop registration for the react-hook-form binding) = 6 catalog calls. Search alone answered tasks 1, 3, 4 and 5, so no further get was used; no IDs were repeated, at most one get per task, no --include props, and no project source or component-catalog.json was read.
